nodeGroups.name: Check submission
nodeGroups.description: Works out whether a YouTube link or an MP4 was sent and rejects empty, double, invalid or oversized input

nodeGroups.name: Get YouTube captions
nodeGroups.description: Looks up the title, stops on private or missing videos, then pulls existing captions from a transcript service

nodeGroups.name: Transcribe uploaded video
nodeGroups.description: Sends the MP4 to speech-to-text and flags silent videos or failed transcriptions

nodeGroups.name: Summarize transcript
nodeGroups.description: Gemini summarizes the transcript (in sections if very long) into a summary, main points and key takeaways

nodeGroups.name: Show result page
nodeGroups.description: Displays the title, status, summary, key points and transcript, or a plain-language error

nodeGroups.name: Understand Telegram message
nodeGroups.description: Sorts each chat message into link, MP4, question or help, and blocks non-MP4 or over-20 MB files early

nodeGroups.name: Send result to Telegram
nodeGroups.description: Remembers the video for this chat, then posts summary, key points and transcript in several messages, or the error

nodeGroups.name: Answer follow-up questions
nodeGroups.description: Looks up the last video for this chat and answers only from its transcript and summary, keeping chat history
